trace.cypher: MATCH (o:Owner)-[:Owns]->(t:Team)-[:LocatedIn]->(c:City) WHERE EXISTS { MATCH (o)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) } AND EXISTS { MATCH (t)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) } AND EXISTS { MATCH (c)-[:MentionedIn]->(:Document) } RETURN DISTINCT t.team_name AS col1, c.city_name AS col2, t.founded_year AS col3, o.name AS col4, t.team_name AS name_team, o.name AS name_manager
